cohort: Nulliparous women with unripe cervix, eligible for vaginal delivery and medical induction of labour
finding: While both methods resulted in similar rates of vaginal delivery and cesarean section, vaginal misoprostol led to quicker delivery but with an increased risk of tachysystole compared to oral misoprostol.
mod_finding: Induction of labor with vaginal slow-release misoprostol led to quicker delivery but an increased risk of tachysystole compared to low-dose oral misoprostol, with both methods resulting in similar rates of cesarean section.
